title: ForecastingShare - Data API
description: Represents forecasts shared between a forecast manager and a user. Available in API version 44.0 and later.

AccessLevel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
AccessLevel.description: Whether the user you’re sharing your forecasts with can view and adjust the forecasts or view only. This field is new since the pilot. Picklist values: ViewAndEdit ViewOnly

SharedForecastManagerRoleId.description: The ID of either: The role of the manager whose forecasts you want to share. The territory whose forecasts you want to share.

RoleType.description: The type of hierarchy associated with the forecast share. R - Role-based T - Territory-based Y - Territory2-based

UserOrGroupId.description: The ID of the user with whom the forecast is shared.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.
usage: Use this object to let any stakeholder at your company view and adjust forecast managers’ forecasts.
